title: A prompt tool joins the project list
summary:
A new community prompt tool joined the project list, and Mindcraft’s links got a tidy-up.

DeepSeek Prompt was added to the Chat projects list. The community app organizes prompt templates, supports drag-and-drop sorting and import/export, and uses Pollinations APIs to help improve prompts.

The Mindcraft game listing now points to mindcraft.riqvip.dev and the maintained mindcraft-ce repository.
